results.title: Tiny Little Office: A tiny office suite where the link is the document | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hunting this for Paul Ford (@ftrain), who built it at Aboard, where I'm CTO.  
  
The trick is that there's no backend. Every document is Markdown packed into the URL after the #, so your browser never sends it anywhere. Ten apps (a word processor, spreadsheet, slides, outliner, calculator, drawing, diagrams, animation, calendar, trip planner), each one small on purpose, and a document from one can sit inside another: a spreadsheet on a slide, an animation in a doc.  
  
No accounts, no uploads, nothing stored on a server unless you use the optional link shortener, and even then it's encrypted with the key in the link. It's open source, and there's an API if you want to generate documents from code.  
  
Paul's writeup on why he built it: [...] This is fun! Thanks, @ftrain!
